'''Carrick Rangers Football Club''' is a semi-professional Northern Irish [[association football|football]] club playing in [[NIFL Premiership]]. The club, founded in 1939, is based in [[Carrickfergus]], County Antrim, and plays its home matches at [[Taylors Avenue]]. Carrick Rangers main rivals are [[Larne F.C.|Larne]], with matches between the sides being known as, "The East Antrim Derby." [[Ballyclare Comrades]] are also local rivals."}}
